simple.meaning: גָּזָה (gâzâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to cut off , i.e. portion out.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Psalms, beginning at Psalms 71:6. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּזָה (H1491) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: גָּזָה (gâzâh) / H1491 is traced through Psalms 71:6 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.short: to cut off , i.e. portion out
